description:
Record the verdict of a judge loop you have COMPLETED for the design you are working on — the final step of the `judge` skill. Recording is a claim about work already done: never call this without having scored the axes against actual `preview` renders of the design in its current state.

`verdict: 'pass'` — every applicable axis scored ≥ 8; the design may be delivered. `verdict: 'fail'` — you are stopping with an axis below 8 (e.g. the user cut remediation short); the failure stays on record.

There is no `revision`: the verdict covers the session as it stands when you record it, and ANY later `edit` or `import` clears it — so judge last, and re-judge after every further change. `export` checks it: delivering or saving a design the latest verdict does not cover adds a reminder to its result.

verdict.description: 'pass' when every applicable axis scored ≥ 8, 'fail' when stopping below the gate.

name: scorecard
